LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliHideoutSitePart.label: Hideout of the Nonexistent
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliHideoutSitePart.description: A temporary refuge surfaced from a gap in reality. Zhaoli waits there for the caravan's answer.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliHideoutSitePart.arrivedLetter: Zhaoli is at the center of this map. She will not move and cannot be harmed, but she will remember the choice you make here.
